description:
Remove one stored trace by id; its spans go with it, and every evaluation linked to it keeps its verdict and loses its text.

What it does. Linked evaluations keep their verdicts and scores; their text is erased and erased_at is stamped. deleted is false when no trace has that id. Every deletion is audited at iris://audit. Full detail: iris://capabilities.

When not to use it. To expire data in bulk (retention.days). To change a trace: traces are immutable.

Returns. JSON: deleted, trace_id.

Errors. IRIS_STORAGE_ERROR. A malformed trace_id is refused. Failures return {"error":{code,message,recovery}} with isError; follow recovery.

Siblings. log_trace — store a trace; get_traces — find the trace to delete; delete_rule — the equivalent for custom rules.

trace_id.description: Trace id to delete (32-hex lowercase; obtained from log_trace response or get_traces)

name: delete_trace
